Period of execution: Preparation jobs has to be started immediately after placement of order and issue of materials by t he department. The successful tenderer shall have to submit a plan in consultation with GM (Electrical), Sinter Plant-III, for smooth execution of the jobs. However the schedule is subject to change to suit the production exigency and party should be ready to do the jobs in the rev. period. 2. The party should inspect the site and see the working condition before quote. All the relevant drawings referred to in technical specification are available in planning cell of sinter plant III. 3. Everyday, before commencing of work #permit to work" on prescribed format must be collected by the supervisor. Afte r completion of job, a job completion report shall be given by the party and shall be counter-signed by the executing office r after inspection/ verification. 4. For maintenance work, the party shall arrange and keep at site all standard tested tools & tackles of reputed make. 5. MCB/timer/contactor/lamp/gear box /cable/rope/chain/drum/winch shall be provided by the department. The party shall r eceive these items from sinter plant-iii(e) stores and transport to site at his own cost/ arrangement. Defective items (after re

placement) shall be returned to RSP stores. 6. Good electrical practice shall be followed for all repair / maintenance work and the job shall be done as per directions of t he executing officer. 7. The party shall provide PPEs to its employees at its own cost. PPEs must be used as per prevailing RSP safety procedure . 8. Safety clearance must be obtained before starting the job. Ensuring the safety of the workmen shall be the responsibility o f the party. 9. The party shall abide by and fulfill all safety rules, labour laws & statutory procedures of RSP in force. 10. Temporary stores constructed for storage and safe custody of above items will have to be dismantled by the party aft er the jobs are over. 11. All scraps arising shall be shifted to a place shown by the department. 12. The handling and transport facilities inside the plant like cranes, wagons, winches, tractor, scaffolding materials, ladders etc required for the assigned jobs will be provided to the contractor free of cost unless otherwise stated. However, f or plates and pipes collection truck and trailer will not be provided by RSP. Partyhas to arrange thet railer. 13. The firm should deploy competent TECHNICAL PERSONS having similar job experience. 14. THE JOB HAS TO BE ATTENDED WITHIN 24 HOURS OF INFORMING THE TEN DERER. HOWEVER, IN BREAKDOWN CASES, JOB IS TO BE ATTENDED IMMEDIATELY. 15. All other general safety terms and conditions for repair jobs as given in purchase enquiry will also be applicable for thi s case. 16. Penalty clause if attributable to the contractor # a. The firm should start the job within 3 weeks (21 days) of the date of PO placement or as directed by the department, whic h ever is later. In failing to do so, a penalty of Rs 1000 per day (excluding GST) will be imposed on the firm from next day onwards till start day of the job. Total penalty will be limited to maximum 10% of the total contract value. b. Any delay in resolving the breakdown/ emergency call Then penalty of Rs. 3000/- per instance will be imposed. Inspection Agency:- AUTHORISED REPRESENTATIVE OF SP-III(ELECTRICAL). Workmanship Reqd Perf / Maint:- WORKMANSHIP SHOULD BE DULY CERTIFIED BY SITE-IN-CHARGES ON REGULAR BASIS. PARTY HAS TO STAND GUARANTEE FOR THE WORKMANSHIP FOR TOTAL DURATION OF THE CONTRACT.ANY FAILURE IN TH E EXECUTED JOBS, DUE TO BAD WORKMANSHIP, DURING THE GUARANTEE PERIOD OF 12 MONTHS IS TO BE REPAIRED BY T HE PARTY WITHOUT ANY ADDITIONAL COST.
